name: yueqi-hotel-ops
description: 悦栖连锁酒店内部日常业务管理系统（HR与报销流程）

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev:demo" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
